title: Prove and attain the 39-helper P104 Y2 acquisition bound
head: f13badee663016e3e487e5183cc3cb03cd474cf4
body:
P104 Y2's twelve later-access sources can share three chronological acquisition paths. This gives an exact **39 new dirty helper lifetime minimum** in the stated X-only monotone relay model: 36 sources are forced to their initial lines, and sources 3/6/15 complete a 39-source all-allowed-frame antichain. A literal 39-helper word attains it while restoring every arbitrary dirty input.

This closes PR2460's explicit late contained-frame acquisition handoff and changes its initial-line acquisition premise. It does not repeat Y0's 48-helper result or claim the earlier three-target 94 minimum is unrestricted. The new package contains a written arbitrary-length lower-bound argument, complete circuit and receipt, independent sparse Fraction and dense quarter-integer/echelon checkers, source pins, task metadata, controls and open next questions.

The full word has 4,354 events and 319 independent inputs; all 101,761 endpoint coefficients check. Y2 becomes y2+x2; the other 103 targets retain their original G/2 updates. Added local bill: **174 ADDs, 122 nested transports, 80 H1 + H2 + 3 H3 + 2 H4 + 36 H7, and 351 ZERO-to-FULL boundary ranks**. Lifetimes are not simultaneous registers and boundary progress is not recursive excess cost.

Validation on standard-library Python 3.12.14: optimized registered replay, complete literal regeneration, seven primary rejection controls, equivalent-basis positive control, separate dense replay/two faults, baseline bindings, Git-free export with all eleven files unchanged, and clean diff check pass. A separate AI-assisted reviewer checked the scoped proof and reran the dense checker; no independent human/formal-kernel review or hosted CI pass is claimed.

Reproduce:
```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-y2-late-acquisition
```

Canonical main was fetched at start and pre-submission and remains 0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2, priority revision 4. Pre-submission metadata overlap covers 693 open PRs with complete pagination at 12:41:47 UTC. Required public Start-here/Handoff pages were read via Curiosity Bot; paginated Discussion coverage was rate-limited and is not claimed complete. Advance scope: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2460#issuecomment-6192232180.

No native phases/scalar-address lowering, global owner/idle bill, physical precision/tape, all-size admission, complete supplier or new kappa. Selected/frontier records and frozen sources are unchanged. Credit PR2460's late-frame handoff, Ross Richardson/PR2445, commdata2338/PR2393, Hiroki Kumazaki/PR2353, Philippe Van Velzen, Rohan Arun/PR1972, Chafik Boukhalfa/PR1991, Adam Gall/PR1940, Josie Elliston/PR1071, Ali Romman/PR1125 and the retained geometry/compiler lineage.
